title: fix(router): skip history push on browser back and forward actions
body:

Issue was reported here https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/4740
The main issue is that after popstate event is fired, router.write method is called where pushState confuse the browser history. So next time you try to go back wrong state will be used. Fix will prevent pushState on popstate event.
